title: The Brooklyn Synagogue Tunnel: Facts vs. Inventions
hero_object: Official NYC Department of Buildings (DOB) Architectural Inspection Blueprint
hook: The tunnel was real. That doesn’t make every story about it true.
punchline: Investigate what happened. Don’t add what you can’t prove.
visual_paradigm: Forensic Structural Blueprint & Urban Mapping (Architectural Navy #0B132B, Laser Cyan #00F0FF, Warning Coral #FF5757)

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: The tunnel was real. That doesn’t make every story about it true.
scenes.on_screen: THE TUNNEL WAS REAL. THE RUMORS WEREN'T.

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: In January twenty-twenty-four, an unauthorized underground passageway was uncovered beside a historic Brooklyn synagogue at seven-seventy Eastern Parkway.
scenes.source: NYC Department of Buildings Official Report

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: Within hours, social media added wild claims: stories claiming it led to a children’s museum, or connected to global criminal networks.
scenes.on_screen: UNVERIFIED CLAIMS ADDED TO REAL EVENT

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: Here is what the city inspection actually found. The structural engineering report documented a sixty-foot rudimentary trench dug between two adjacent synagogue basements by unauthorized students trying to expand prayer space.

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: It did not cross the street. It did not touch any museum. Synagogue leadership condemned the excavation and called building inspectors immediately.

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: A real municipal safety violation was weaponized into ancient folklore. Look at the verified blueprints, not the runaway rumors.

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: Investigate what happened. Don’t add what you can’t prove.
scenes.on_screen: DON'T ADD WHAT YOU CAN'T PROVE
scenes.source: Beyond the Myth · Facts, not scapegoats
